name: The Binding
summary: Gakin the Darkbinder asks you to use a wooden figurine in the crypts and face an incubus. Your success decides whether he can teach you to call upon the demon.

sections.title: A Trial in the Crypts
sections.body: Gakin the Darkbinder has prepared a summoning circle in the crypts below the Slaughtered Lamb. You place a wooden figurine at its center to open a way for an incubus, a sayaad demon. It may try to beguile you, but Gakin warns that anything it offers is false. Your soul is at stake if you fail.

sections.title: The Binding Lesson
sections.body: After you best the incubus, Gakin praises your unbroken will. He says many warlocks who attempt to bind a sayaad become its next meal. Then he teaches you the invocation to call upon the incubus you have bound.

faq.q: What does Gakin want me to do?
aliases: what am I supposed to do
faq.answer: Gakin asks you to use a wooden figurine at the summoning circle in the crypts, subdue the incubus, and return the figurine to him.
Gakin says the summoning circle is in the crypts below the Slaughtered Lamb.
A sayaad is a demon, and Gakin warns that one should not be underestimated.

faq.q: Why should I distrust the incubus?
faq.answer: Gakin warns that the incubus may use beguilement and deception, and that anything it offers is false.

faq.q: What does Gakin teach after the trial?
faq.answer: After you best the incubus, Gakin teaches you the invocation to call upon the demon you have bound.

angles.text: As a warlock, you face Gakin's trial to bind a sayaad and learn an invocation to call upon the incubus.
